requirement: A design system worn on a Vietnamese site never prints the site's letters in two faces: a family without the Vietnamese cut is replaced whole

oracle.ref: PR #1297 (fix); fix evidence: Local stand 13/10/2026: a Vietnamese Tracy Business EmDash site wearing Balsa (Bebas Neue, no Vietnamese cut on Google) printed 'BÁNH MÌ NướNG MỖI SÁNG', the accented letters in another face and in lower case (tasks/evidence/site-questions-2026-10-13/shots/ds-l1/).
oracle.invariant: 'a Vietnamese site wearing Bebas Neue gets Oswald, asked of Google as a browser; Inter, which has the cut, stays' is ok. 'EmDash: the stylesheet names Oswald everywhere it named Bebas Neue, and loads it', 'Joomla: the module markup links and names the replacement' and "WordPress: the variation's family is renamed and wears the replacement's faces, never the old ones" are ok. 'nothing is replaced when the site is not written in a language with letters of its own' is ok. 'a Vietnamese site wearing a system whose display face has no Vietnamese cut is written with a face that has one' is ok: the door's write and audit carry fontsSwapped Bebas Neue → Oswald. 'a site whose language cannot be read is written as the system made it, and the write never waits on it for long' is ok.
